subject: Portal recertification + upsell timing: vendor steps & PO cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Harris Cole <harris@procureops.com>, contracts@aurora-health.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Portal recertification + capacity uplift -- timeline ask

Hi Harris / Aurora contracts team,

We’re coming up on Aurora Health’s renewal window (contract RDW-3249) and the customer is requesting a 30% capacity uplift alongside a one-year term extension. Procurement flagged that our vendor record needs recertification in ProcureOps before they can issue an updated PO.

Quick asks:
- What exact documents do you need uploaded into ProcureOps to expedite a PO? (SOC2, W-9, banking, SOW amendment?)
- Is there a fast-track for strategic renewals so we don’t miss the customer’s internal purchasing cutoff (targeting week of Jan 19)?

I’ve attached the latest SOC2 PDF and the vendor-onboard-form we usually send — please confirm if anything else is required.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf, vendor-onboard-form.xlsx

From: Harris Cole <harris@procureops.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, contracts@aurora-health.com
Cc: Kelly Taylor <kelly.taylor@aurora-health.com>
Date: 2026-01-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal recertification + capacity uplift -- timeline ask

Hi Monica — thanks for the heads up. Short answers first:
- Required items for recertification: signed vendor form (we need the legal name + remit address), SOC2 Type II report, current W-9, and a primary contact for billing. For tech customers we also recommend a short uptime SLA summary PDF (optional).
- Fast-track: yes, we have a "Strategic Renewal" lane. It requires a single-point contact + a PO-ready invoice and a confirmed contract amendment. If those are submitted by Jan 14 we can route to the priority queue and aim for PO issuance by Jan 20.

Next steps I’ll take:
1) I’ll create the ProcureOps recertification ticket for Aurora and send an upload link.
2) Once you upload the signed vendor form + W-9 + SOC2 we’ll validate and ping Aurora procurement for the PO.

I’ve provisionally created ticket #PO-9813 and attached the secure upload link below. If you want, I can also accept the PO via email and add it to the priority queue.

Upload link: https://portal.procureops.com/vendor/recertify/aurora
Ticket: PO-9813

Best,
Harris
Harris Cole | Vendor Ops Lead, ProcureOps
harris@procureops.com

-----Original attachment stub: vendor-onboard-form.xlsx (spreadsheet; please sign and re-upload)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Harris Cole <harris@procureops.com>, Kelly Taylor <kelly.taylor@aurora-health.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-07T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal recertification + capacity uplift -- timeline ask

Thanks Harris — that timeline helps. Kelly / Aurora team, can you confirm:
- Internal approval: are you able to finalize the PO week of Jan 19 if ProcureOps marks us strategic?
- Billing contact: please confirm the remit address and whether Aurora requires consolidated invoicing per month or per quarter.

Laura / Aditya — internal note: Aurora is asking for a 30% capacity increase with a term extension; procurement will not approve additional spend until recertification is complete. If we want to avoid losing the commit, we should consider offering a one-time credits buffer (30 days of free burst) or commit to delivery SLAs in the amendment. Thoughts?

I’ll sign the vendor form and upload the SOC2 + W-9 by EOD.

Monica

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-09T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal recertification + capacity uplift -- timeline ask

Monica / team — quick internal take:
- We should not give a blanket free credits offer yet. Offer A: a 30-day burst credit for the first 90 days after renewal if Aurora signs the amendment by Jan 15. Offer B: a fixed per-token discount for the first 6 months in exchange for an annual commitment.
- Legal will need to sign the amendment; I’ll loop in Aditya for a fast review.
- Finance: Rachel, can you confirm whether we can accept a Jan 21 PO date but recognize revenue starting Feb 1 if that helps Aurora get BU approval?

Aditya — please prioritize a short amendment draft (1 page) that: 1) adds 30% capacity, 2) extends term by 12 months, 3) includes the temporary burst credit clause. I’ll get it to Legal for a redline.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
